reported.quote: Consolidated revenue grew by 53% year-on-year, with all business segments contributing meaningfully to this growth momentum.
EBITDA increased by 39% year-on-year, while EBITDA margins expanded by more than 50 basis points sequentially to 14.4%

EBITDA increased by 39% year-on-year, while EBITDA margins expanded by more than 50 basis points sequentially to 14.4%, supported by a favourable business mix and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
Profitability remained robust, with profit after tax reaching a record high of INR 9,900 million, representing a 43% year-over-year increase.
PAT margins stood at 10.0% for the quarter, reflecting healthy earnings growth and sustained margin resilience.
Net cash stood at INR 45.2 billion as of September 30th, 2026, compared to INR 29.4 billion a year ago.
We also witnessed further improvement in our working capital efficiency, with the average working capital cycle reducing to approximately 11 days in second quarter fiscal '27.

During the first half of the year, we incurred capital expenditures of INR 6.1 billion, reflecting our ongoing investments in capacity expansion, supply chain capabilities and future growth platforms.
Revenue grew by 46% year-on-year, crossing a significant milestone of INR180 billion.
EBITDA increased by 36% year-on-year, with margins remaining healthy at 14.1%, while profit after tax grew by 38% year-on-year, translating into PAT margins of 9.9%.

The Wires and Cables segment delivered a strong quarter, recording 47% year-on-year revenue growth.

reported.metric: domestic Wires and Cables revenue growth
reported.quote: Within this, the domestic Wires and Cables business grew by an impressive 50% year-on-year, driven by healthy demand conditions, strong channel execution and favourable commodity linked realizations.
The FMEG segment delivered a breakthrough quarter, registering a remarkable 124% year-on-year growth with strong performance across all major product categories.
The segment also achieved a major profitability milestone, with EBIT margins crossing the double-digit mark for the first time and recording a 10.1% margin during the quarter.
